generation_policy: Modern copyrighted textbook sources are local study references only.
Do not generate a full-text republication from the PDFs for public distribution.
Preferred output is a private PocketPolyglot study-note book: original explanations, terminology tables, concise legal quotations only where necessary, and newly written exercises.
Preserve formulas, diagrams, chord symbols, scale degrees, fretboard examples, and table structure when creating private study notes.

For guitar technique and music-theory material, keep notation examples, staff fragments, rhythm grids, fretboard diagrams, chord charts, figures, captions, and exercises as structured TeX/figure assets.
Do not replace technical examples with prose-only summaries; every figure/equation/diagram/table needed for learning must be represented or explicitly marked for manual review.
Use English as the study spine for the two prepared tasks; use Japanese and Chinese sources as terminology/reference material.
